As an Ex-Google recruiter, I've watched qualified candidates not land interviews by being "too honest" in their resumes.

After reviewing 136,000+ resumes at Google, TikTok, Uber, Lyft, and The New York Times, I'm sharing the things you absolutely cannot lie about and the things you can stretch on your resume. These resume tips will change how you approach your resume to land the interview you want.
